recognize_zh: 周邊血液中兩顆中等大小淋巴樣細胞，核圓、染色質中度凝集，具有比一般小淋巴球更多的淡藍色細胞質，呈輕度漿細胞樣（plasmacytoid）外觀；形態不具特異性，需結合 IgM 單株蛋白與 MYD88 L265P 突變來診斷 Waldenström 巨球蛋白血症。
features: Two medium-sized lymphoid cells, larger than normal small lymphocytes
Round, slightly eccentric nuclei with moderately condensed, somewhat open chromatin
Moderate rim of pale blue, finely granular-appearing cytoplasm with lighter perinuclear zone
No nucleoli, cleft, or villous projections evident
Background red cells normocytic with central pallor; rouleaux not prominent in this field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two medium-sized lymphoid cells with round, slightly eccentric nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin, and a moderate amount of pale blue cytoplasm imparting a mildly plasmacytoid appearance. Red cells are normocytic and normochromic without conspicuous rouleaux in this field. The morphology is nonspecific; in the context of an IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P mutation, these cells are consistent with circulating lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma cells.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous with abundant cytoplasm that scallops around red cells, and are polyclonal on flow cytometry.
SMZL cells often show polar villous cytoplasmic projections; overlap with LPL is resolved by MYD88 L265P and clinicopathologic correlation.
Plasma cells have eccentric nuclei with clock-face chromatin, deeply basophilic cytoplasm, and a prominent hof, and are CD19-negative/CD138-positive.
CLL cells are smaller with scant cytoplasm and soccer-ball chromatin and are CD5+/CD23+.
